item.title: Pegfinity
item.description:
Title: Pegfinity
Genre: Casual , Indie
Developer: Fragment Ventures AS
Publisher: Fragment Ventures AS
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

What if one ball could break the entire board?

Pegfinity is a colorful, pachinko-inspired physics-based incremental where a single shot can spiral into massive chain reactions, exploding scores, and absurd combos.

Launch balls, hit pegs, unlock chaotic upgrades, and turn a simple board into a ridiculous score-chasing machine.

You are always one lucky bounce away from your biggest run yet.

Between runs, unlock upgrades that push every shot further and make the board more chaotic.

  • Stack multipliers with the Hypemeter

  • Fill the board with explosive, electric, and gold pegs

  • Unlock gadgets that cheat physics: lasers, portals, a gumball machine, even a pinball bumper

  • Launch special balls that shatter, zap, spray watermelon juice, or disco the whole screen

  • Discover pegs that steal the run: chickens, UFOs, mirrors, clowns, and an atomic bomb that hits everything

  • Chase bigger combos, bigger payouts, and bigger score spikes

With over 150 upgrades to discover, every run gives you new ways to bend the board in your favor.
Every board is randomly generated. Every upgrade sticks. The game keeps handing you new ways to break it.

From simple bounces to ridiculous chaos

End with a board filled with effects, combos, and massive score spikes. Each run escalates:

  • More hits

  • Bigger numbers

  • More unpredictable outcomes

You’re always one lucky bounce away from your biggest run yet.

A Satisfying Progression Loop

Every hit is a small dopamine boost. Every run builds toward something bigger. Short sessions turn into long ones.

You launch one ball…

Then another…

Then one more to try something new…

And suddenly, everything clicks.

Permanent Power-Ups

Grow stronger over time with upgrades that carry across runs:

  • Multipliers

  • Stronger pegs

  • Bigger payouts

  • Game-changing boosts

Each run feeds into the next.

Inspired by a 150-year-old game

Pegfinity is inspired by a handcrafted pachinko-style board passed down through generations.

A simple idea, rebuilt into something faster, bigger, and far more chaotic.

  • Over 150 upgrades

  • Unlock unique pegs, balls, slots and cool gadgets

  • Random generated board - Each run is something new!

  • Permanent unlockable Power Ups!

  • And of course some biiiiiiiiiiig numbers!

See you in Pegfinity!

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
    • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: DirectX 12 or Vulkan compatible, 1 GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 500 MB available space
    • Sound Card: Anything that can play sound
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
    • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: DirectX 12 or Vulkan compatible, 2 GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 500 MB available space

item.title: Static Dread: The Submarine
item.description:
Title: Static Dread: The Submarine
Genre: Adventure , Indie , Simulation
Developer: solarsuit.games
Publisher: Polden Publishing
Franchise: Static Dread
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

A psychological horror set in a Lovecraftian setting, blending with the cold reality of a military submarine trapped in the depths of the North Atlantic. This story follows ordinary people pushed to the brink of madness as they encounter the unthinkable horrors beneath the waves.

LOVECRAFTIAN HORROR

Ancient forces have awakened beneath the ocean, and all contact with the surface is lost. Seek answers at the heart of an apocalypse aboard a nuclear submarine.

MAKE HARD CHOICES

Every crew member is more than just an asset. They are human beings, haunted by their own fears and suffering. You have to make hard choice – complete the mission or preserve your humanity.

YOU ARE IN CHARGE NOW

You are the captain’s right hand. Assign tasks, maintain discipline, and don’t let madness overcome your mind.

LOOK INTO THE ABYSS

Scan the depths with sonar. But remember, not everything in the ocean follows military protocol… Is it another submarine, or something alive?

item.title: Fellwood
item.description:
Title: Fellwood
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Allerton Apps
Publisher: Allerton Apps
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

Build a Powerful Lumber Empire

Unlock and expand a growing lineup of unique buildings, each adding new attacks, upgrades, and ways to harvest the forest faster.

Massive Physics-Driven Log Piles

Watch thousands of logs crash, stack, and spill into enormous piles as your operation scales out of control.

Collectors Keep Things Moving

Your workers haul logs across the valley, turning every fallen tree into income and fueling the next stage of growth.

Build. Upgrade. Grow Stronger.

  • 17 buildings to build and upgrade

  • 80+ permanent Prestige upgrades

  • 100+ level-up options to customize each run

  • Powerful active abilities

  • Random events that shake up your runs

  • Multiple projectile tiers that dramatically increase your firepower

  • Watch your encampment grow from a handful of buildings into complete projectile chaos

item.title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
item.description:
Title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Games Together
Publisher: Games Together , Gamersky Games
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

This is a first-person organization simulation game where you shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive.

Game Modes

Solo, together, or competition...

Enjoy the different game modes: Single player, online co-op, and online PvP.

You can also try "Sandbox Mode", where all your skills are unlocked and always ready to use, or "No-Skill Mode" to challenge yourself.

Videotape Categories

Your task is to shelve 3,180 videotapes into the correct categories in the archive.

Action movies, drama movies, TV series, cartoons, horror movies, comedy movies, athletic games, football cups, romance movies, sci-fi movies, baseball, tennis, news, game shows, basketball, motorsport, cooking shows, documentaries, boxing, and talk shows.

Skills

  • Sorting Numerically: Sorts the videotapes in your hand in numerical order

  • Highlighting Shelf: Highlights the correct shelf for the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Highlighting Videotapes: Highlights the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Auto-Placement: Automatically places your videotapes on the shelf in the correct order

  • Auto-Collect: Automatically collects the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

AI was used only as a supporting tool for the design of fictional images on the videotapes.



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit | Windows 8 64-bit | Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400F | AMD Ryzen 5 5600x
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 | AMD Radeon R9-290X
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 2800 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit | Windows 8 64-bit | Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-13400F | AMD Ryzen 5 7600x
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 | AMD Radeon RX-6600
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 2800 MB available space

item.title: I.T. Never Ends
item.description:
Title: I.T. Never Ends
Genre: Adventure , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Dadbod Games
Publisher: Dadbod Games
Release Date: Aug 14, 2026




About This Game

Ticket #404: User cannot find their soul.
Ticket #500: The printer is breathing again.
Ticket #237: URGENT - Floor 3.5 won't stop existing.

In I.T. NEVER ENDS , you are the newly hired Systems Administrator at a company that was definitely founded in 2015, regardless of what the USB drive buried in the wall says.

Your job? Process tickets. Keep the lights on. Don't let the coffee machine's prophecies ruin anyone's morning.

The pay is bad. The hours are worse. If any of your metrics hit zero, you're gone . And something tells you the Bahamas aren't in your future.

Every day brings a deluge of tech support requests from your coworkers. The interface is simple. The choices are not.

  • SWIPE TO SURVIVE: Gary needs his password reset to GaryRocks123 . Again. The brute-force bots are thrilled. Swipe Right to approve or Swipe Left to deny. Both options have consequences.

  • BALANCE FOUR METRICS: Productivity. Budget. Morale. Entropy. Let any one flatline and your shift ends. Permanently. Let Entropy climb too high and the building starts... remembering things.

  • EVERY TICKET MATTERS: That keyboard pulsating with ectoplasm? Not your biggest problem. The elevator now goes to a floor that doesn't exist. Three coworkers have been texting "almost back" for an hour. And Legal needs VPN access from somewhere redacted .

Get your hands dirty with tactile Manual Override Minigames :

  • REDACT FORBIDDEN TEXT: Marketing accidentally CC'd the summoning ritual to the whole company. Again. Censor the document before anyone reads it and loses their mind. Some things were not meant for mortal eyes.

  • STABILIZE THE NETWORK: The server room has developed its own weather system. Patch Packet Loss , plug violent Stack Overflows , and reroute power before rack 7 floods. It rains at 2:47 PM. Precisely.

  • HUNT ROGUE DATA: Track volatile data entities through the server architecture before they corrupt something important or find you first.

"Connection lost, like ships in stormy sea / The server sleeps, and will not answer thee."
Actual error message. Beautiful but unhelpful.

You are employee #47. Or maybe #48. The numbers keep changing.

Punch in. Process tickets. Don't ask what happened to Marvin.
